description: Row-wise softmax on a 2D matrix using a single Triton kernel. Each program instance processes one row: computes max, exponentiates, and normalizes. Measures memory bandwidth (GB/s).

scaling_param.name: n
scaling_param.description: Number of columns per row (row width); total elements = M x N

non_scaling_params.name: m
non_scaling_params.description: Number of rows in the input matrix

non_scaling_params.name: dtype
non_scaling_params.description: Data type of input and output tensors

non_scaling_params.name: num_warps
non_scaling_params.description: Number of warps per Triton program instance
